chapters.label: The block, live
chapters.text: São Paulo, 2014: the World Cup semi-final, Netherlands against Argentina. The last minute, and no goals yet. Arjen Robben breaks into the box... but Javier Mascherano chases him down and blocks the shot!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. Robben gets in behind. Mascherano does not give up. He stays on his feet and tracks the run.

chapters.label: The slide
chapters.text: Robben takes one more touch. Now Mascherano slides, and blocks it with the bottom of his boot!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: stay on your feet as long as you can. Only slide when you are sure you can reach the ball!
